items.title: Qwen1.5-MoE: Matching 7B Model Performance with 1/3 Activated Parameters
items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD Introduction Since the surge in interest sparked by Mixtral, research on mixture-of-expert (MoE) models has gained significant momentum. Both researchers and practitioners are keenly interested in understanding how to effectively train such models and assessing their efficiency and effectiveness. Today, we introduce Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, a small MoE model with only 2.7 billion
items.summaryZh: 顺应混合专家模型（MoE）的发展趋势，通义千问推出了Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B。该模型仅需激活27亿参数，便能匹配Mistral 7B和Qwen1.5-7B等顶尖7B模型的性能，展示了MoE架构在保持高效推理的同时兼顾强大生成能力的潜力。

aiReview.reasonZh: 通义千问发布了Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B混合专家模型，以极低的激活参数量实现了与主流7B模型相媲美的性能。
